ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels to low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Localized high-intensity white patch at the distal tip of the right lobe; extensive network of high-contrast white linear streaks and circular spots distributed across the medial and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior pixel angle of 70 degrees and a moderate vertical depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel fluctuations; the right lobe exhibits more irregular, jagged peaks compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges tapering to acute points at the tips; the trailing edge displays a general concave-outward sweep from the notch toward the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-intensity pixel clusters (approximately 10-30 pixels in diameter) localized in the mid-left and lower-central fluke regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense, multi-directional network of parallel and intersecting light-colored linear marks (rake marks) covering over 50% of the visible dark pigmented area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes; minor irregular pixel boundaries at the tips suggesting potential historical tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly concentrated, mottled white patch at the distal tip of the right lobe which contrasts significantly with the predominantly dark pigmentation.
